comments.author: The_Bungoolator
comments.body_html: how does the percentage work? nothing is changing when i change the values

comments.author: sgtlaggy
comments.body_html:
With a flat value of 0 or higher set in the xCount setting, that will always be used. If you set a value of, for example, 25 in the xPercent setting and an objective has a requirement of 10, it will be changed to 2 (10 * 0.25 = 2.5, rounding to even). Similarly, setting a percent of 200 would change that requirement to 20.

Testing shows it works on a fresh profile and if you already have tasks partially completed with values higher than the new percentage requirement, those should be counted as complete.

comments.body_html: Sorry, I’m not very good at coding. How do I override multiple quests? For example, I’d like Drip Out Part 1 and 2 to both not be Found in Raid. I got both the IDs from Tarkynator, but I don’t know how to format it in the config json.

comments.author: sgtlaggy
comments.body_html:
Add "quest id": {"findInRaid": true} to the overrides for each with a comma between them so it would look something like

"questOverrides": {
  "id": {"findInRaid": true},
  "id": {"findInRaid": true}
},
